reel.caption:
How much gratuity do you get after 5 years in a job?

Gratuity = 15/26 × your last monthly wages (basic + DA) × years of service.
Illustrative: ₹40,000 wages × 5 years ≈ ₹1,15,385.
In a permanent job, you need 5 years of continuous service to qualify.
Fixed-term contracts now qualify after 1 year, paid pro-rata, under the new labour codes.
